Use case: stylized-concept.

Input image is ONLY the private original silhouette/color reference of Potion of Full Healing, item.design.base.potion-of-full-healing, ICURS_POTION_OF_FULL_HEALING 35. Reconstruct one coherent physical object from this image; do not substitute the tall rectangular regular Healing potion design.
Create a clean realistic HD turnaround board of the exact SAME squat ROUND-BELLIED glass bottle in FRONT, SIDE, BACK and THREE-QUARTER views plus a small NEW HD rendered inventory-composition thumbnail. Plain charcoal-gray backdrop and neutral soft studio light, whole objects widely spaced, restrained realistic material wear. Labels only POTION OF FULL HEALING / FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3-4 / ICON.
Preserve the reference's broad bulbous red-filled lower body, sloping shoulders to a short narrow dark neck, protruding dark burgundy stopper, pale dull-metal lip and ochre-gold loops/bands around the neck with a short hanging cord on one side. The body is squat and rounded, not square, not a tall rectangular flask. The red liquid is rich dark ruby with a physically flat fill surface and ordinary glass reflections; not glowing or magical. For the candidate infer clear slightly smoky glass, opaque burgundy cork and worn golden/ochre cord as plausible materials; their exact construction, unseen rear and thickness are inferred. Keep one consistent fill height, stopper shape, band count, knot/cord attachment, glass thickness and belly proportions across all views. BACK is the opposite face, so the side cord moves naturally to the opposite projected side rather than being a second bottle.
The ICON must be newly rendered HD from the SAME proposed bottle, never pasted original sprite pixels. No character/hand, label text on bottle, runes, spell lettering, ornate metal cage, extra gems, neon, scenery, large floor shadow or alternate variants. This physical bottle does not represent individual spell or label variants. Keep reference silhouette and colors more important than generic fantasy-potion styling.
